title: An hour that is not the middle of someone's night
variant: No libraries at all: Intl knows every time zone already
prompt: Find us a time that works for people in London, New York, LA, Bengaluru and Sydney.
note: The cover, and the one that argues the template's central rule hardest: it opens on five cities that have no good answer, and it says so -- 'there is no good window, this is the least bad one' -- instead of ranking three bad hours and presenting the top one as a result. A tool that can return a bad verdict is a tool you can trust with a good one. It loads nothing: local hours come from the browser's own IANA database through `Intl.DateTimeFormat`, so half-hour offsets and daylight saving are correct without a byte of it being written down. The date is fixed at 14 April 2026 and printed, because an overlap computed 'today' is a quietly different answer next month.
